rules.name: rrr-mtm-sum-order
rules.sql: SELECT c.ctid::text AS row_pos, c.trade_id, c.contract_number, upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client, c.client_code, c.derivative_type, c.opt_periodicity, c.is_premium_paid, c.product_code, c.active_lots::text AS active_lots, c.mult_factor::text AS mult_factor, c.nc_factor::text AS nc_factor, c.fx_nc_factor::text AS fx_nc_factor, c.traded_price::text AS traded_price, c.mtm_usd::text AS mtm_usd, c.mtm_nc::text AS mtm_nc, c.mkt_value_usd::text AS mkt_value_usd, c.premium_paid_usd::text AS premium_paid_usd, c.premium_paid_nc::text AS premium_paid_nc FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1) AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.contract_number IS NOT NULL AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('ADP','ALG','ASI','BSB','BUN','CAD','CDL','CFC','CGL','CWE','DFE','DYE', 'EDF','FAB','GAE','GBS','JUP','MAN','MDL','MFE','MOA','OAA','OBC','OCC','OGM','ORM','PBE','RWF','SBC','SCE','SIC','SIP', 'SOR','SSO','TSR','UDA','VBN','VCI','WSF','ACL','ALV','BEG','BKP','BOC','CBS','CTL','DCS','DFS','GBT','GIL','IVO')

SELECT p.ordinality AS ord, p.trade_id, p.contract_number, p.client_code, p.counterparty_parent, p.derivative_type, p.opt_periodicity, p.is_premium_paid, p.product_code, p.active_lots::text AS active_lots, p.mult_factor::text AS mult_factor, p.original_premium::text AS original_premium, p.nc_factor::text AS nc_factor, p.fx_nc_factor::text AS fx_nc_factor, p.mtm_usd::text AS mtm_usd, p.mtm_nc::text AS mtm_nc, p.mkt_value_usd::text AS mkt_value_usd, p.mkt_value_nc::text AS mkt_value_nc, p.fixing_date FROM opera.fn_client_statement_position_rows_v2( (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1), CAST('CFS' AS text), CAST(:valueDate AS date), CAST('["ADP","ALG","ASI","BSB","BUN","CAD","CDL","CFC","CGL","CWE","DFE","DYE","EDF","FAB","GAE","GBS","JUP","MAN","MDL","MFE","MOA","OAA","OBC","OCC","OGM","ORM","PBE","RWF","SBC","SCE","SIC","SIP","SOR","SSO","TSR","UDA","VBN","VCI","WSF","ACL","ALV","BEG","BKP","BOC","CBS","CTL","DCS","DFS","GBT","GIL","IVO"]' AS jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS p

SELECT c.ctid::text AS row_pos, c.trade_id, c.contract_number, upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client, c.client_code, c.derivative_type, c.opt_periodicity, c.is_premium_paid, c.product_code, c.active_lots::text AS active_lots, c.mult_factor::text AS mult_factor, c.nc_factor::text AS nc_factor, c.fx_nc_factor::text AS fx_nc_factor, c.traded_price::text AS traded_price, c.mtm_usd::text AS mtm_usd, c.mtm_nc::text AS mtm_nc, c.mkt_value_usd::text AS mkt_value_usd, c.premium_paid_usd::text AS premium_paid_usd, c.premium_paid_nc::text AS premium_paid_nc FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'ORM' LIMIT 1) AND c.business_unit = 'ORM' AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.contract_number IS NOT NULL AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('OGA','PRO','QCX','RRP','GBX','GCL','OGX','PAX','SBX','SOX')

SELECT p.ordinality AS ord, p.trade_id, p.contract_number, p.client_code, p.counterparty_parent, p.derivative_type, p.opt_periodicity, p.is_premium_paid, p.product_code, p.active_lots::text AS active_lots, p.mult_factor::text AS mult_factor, p.original_premium::text AS original_premium, p.nc_factor::text AS nc_factor, p.fx_nc_factor::text AS fx_nc_factor, p.mtm_usd::text AS mtm_usd, p.mtm_nc::text AS mtm_nc, p.mkt_value_usd::text AS mkt_value_usd, p.mkt_value_nc::text AS mkt_value_nc, p.fixing_date FROM opera.fn_client_statement_position_rows_v2( (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'ORM' LIMIT 1), CAST('ORM' AS text), CAST(:valueDate AS date), CAST('["OGA","PRO","QCX","RRP","GBX","GCL","OGX","PAX","SBX","SOX"]' AS jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS p

SELECT d.business_unit, d.contract_number, upper(split_part(d.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client, d.mtm_post_dripping_today::text AS mtm_post_dripping_today, d.mtm_post_dripping_today_usd::text AS mtm_post_dripping_today_usd, d.ctid::text AS row_pos FROM opera.client_dripping_table d WHERE d.business_unit IN ('CFS', 'ORM') AND d.value_date = :valueDate
